createPayload.title: MSC-C0R — Admit only translation-safe supine response mixers
createPayload.objective: Admit a mixer on a supine actor only when an explicitly selected touch-response clip is translation-safe by track inspection, while creating no response, locomotion, or standing-idle action at registration.
createPayload.knownGood: Read packages/openclinxr/xr-asset-loading/delegation/supine-mixer-replacement-2026-09-15/handoff.json and cards/c0r.json. Baseline 0569c47e. The committed first clause is an honest it.fails plant: changing only it.fails to it fails because the safe supine actor has no mixer. Preserve RED evidence before product edits, then flip it. Admit from posture + selected response + measured translation tracks; no actor-id string. Registration creates no action for response, walk, or standing idle. Any measured bone translation refuses admission. The implementation must call ctx.translationBoneNames for each selected loaded response. Plant remains active. No index.ts export. Stop at review.
